context: Add an owned-resource table and a small state machine with reserved, live, retiring, retired, and orphaned states. Persist intent before external creation, bind returned identity afterward, and make every transition idempotent and audited. Decision gate: do not add deletion for any resource type until its backing system exposes enough immutable identity to distinguish the created object from a reused name or path.
description: Introduce the durable ownership substrate required for symmetric creation and cleanup. Record reservations, immutable external identities, expected generations, canonical keys, owner task/run/team, lifecycle transitions, and evidence for every resource Bossmode creates. This PR records and reconciles ownership but must not yet delete Herdr workers, worktrees, branches, refs, or scheduler jobs.

anti_patterns.dont: Delete resources in the ownership-ledger PR
anti_patterns.instead: Land record-only ownership and reconciliation first
anti_patterns.why: Each resource type needs separate live-system safety proofs

anti_patterns.dont: Infer ownership from the registry containing a resource name
anti_patterns.instead: Require a reservation plus live immutable identity and generation evidence
anti_patterns.why: Names and paths can be reused

anti_patterns.dont: Use force release as a recovery shortcut
anti_patterns.instead: Mark the resource orphaned and require an explicit evidence-backed resolution
anti_patterns.why: It bypasses evidence and can destroy foreign work

preserves.behavior: A stored display name, pane ID, tab ID, path, or branch name is never sufficient deletion authority.
External resources not created by Bossmode remain attached or observed, never silently adopted as owned.
Lifecycle history remains durable after external resources disappear.
Reconciliation is read-only in this PR.

prior_art.concept: live runtime reconciliation before worker action
Herdr binding and run lifecycle audit records

work_units.evidence: Decision gate independently confirmed: herdr_worker/git_worktree/git_branch deletions require live receipt match + proper state transition (reserved->live->retiring->retired); direct retire on reserved rejected (is not retiring), display name/worker_name/pane ID/path/branch alone insufficient; terminal reuse of canonical key fails closed. Demonstrated via Reserve->BindLive->BeginRetirement->Retire lifecycle and rejected reuse after terminal (test_display_name_not_deletion_authority, live gate script).
work_units.summary: Decision gate: independently confirm every future delete requires a live receipt match and cannot be authorized by name, pane ID, or path alone
